payload.name: KLINGER Immobilien
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
KLINGER Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in Berlin and the surrounding metropolitan area. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, and sell properties throughout Germany's capital region.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand each property's location, surrounding infrastructure, and neighborhood at a glance, creating a faster and more efficient property search experience.

With extensive local market expertise and many years of experience in the Berlin real estate market, KLINGER Immobilien combines personalized service with modern digital solutions to help buyers and sellers navigate today's property market.

Key Benefits

Interactive property search with a modern map-based interface
Faster navigation throughout Berlin and the surrounding region
Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and neighborhoods
Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties
Easy comparison of different districts and municipalities
More efficient property search through visual navigation
Direct contact with experienced real estate professionals
Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for a condominium in Berlin, a family home in the surrounding area, or an attractive investment opportunity, KLINGER Immobilien offers a modern, transparent, and convenient way to explore the real estate market in Berlin and its surrounding region.
payload.longDescription:
KLINGER Immobilien 是一家现代房地产公司，专注于柏林及周边都市圈。该应用通过直观的基于位置的方式，帮助用户在德国首都地区发现、买卖房产。

用户无需浏览冗长的房源列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索可用的房屋、公寓、土地和投资房产，一眼了解房产位置、周边基础设施和社区，从而更快速高效地寻找房产。

凭借深厚的本地市场知识和多年柏林房地产市场经验，KLINGER Immobilien 将个性化服务与现代数字解决方案结合起来，帮助买卖双方应对当今的房地产市场。

主要优势

基于现代地图界面的交互式房产搜索
更快浏览柏林及周边地区
更好了解位置、基础设施和社区
专注于精心筛选的住宅和投资房产
轻松比较不同城区和市镇
通过可视化导航提高搜索效率
直接联系经验丰富的房地产专业人士
现代且易用的移动体验

无论你是在柏林寻找公寓、在周边地区寻找家庭住宅，还是寻找有吸引力的投资机会，KLINGER Immobilien 都能以现代、透明、便捷的方式帮助你探索柏林及周边地区的房地产市场。

payload.name: Botala by dyskute
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Botala te permet de commander des repas et des produits du quotidien auprès de restaurants et boutiques partenaires à Kinshasa, directement dans ChatGPT. Parcours les menus avec photos, recherche des produits par boutique, compose ton panier et confirme tes informations de livraison. Après confirmation, Biloko crée la commande côté serveur et envoie une notification WhatsApp à l’équipe pour la prise en charge. Tu vois toujours un récapitulatif clair (articles, adresse, téléphone, total) avant l’envoi.
payload.longDescription: Botala 让你直接在 ChatGPT 中向 Kinshasa 的合作餐厅和商店订购餐食及日用品。浏览带照片的菜单，按商店搜索商品，组建购物车，并确认配送信息。确认后，Biloko 在服务器端创建订单，并向团队发送 WhatsApp 通知，以便接单处理。提交前，你始终会看到清晰的订单汇总，包括商品、地址、电话和总金额。

payload.name: Weather by WindBorne
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WindBorne lets you harness data from the largest constellation of weather balloons in the world, for a better weather forecast. Each balloon collects critical in-situ data from regions beyond the reach of traditional observation methods, supplying observations to the National Weather Service (NWS), NOAA, and other meteorological agencies.

Ask your agent about the weather and get personalized insights powered by WeatherMesh, WindBorne's world-leading weather forecasting model, AI-based or otherwise.

Get a complete forecast at a glance, explore one variable in depth, or compare conditions across multiple locations. Find the best weather window for a run, flight, or the trip you have yet to plan - or watch storms, fronts, wind, and precipitation unfold on a map.
payload.longDescription:
WindBorne让您利用全球最大的气象气球星座数据，获得更精准的天气预报。每个气球可采集传统观测手段无法覆盖区域的关键实地数据，为美国国家气象局（NWS）、美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）及其他气象机构提供观测信息。

向您的代理询问天气情况，获取由WindBorne全球领先的天气预测模型WeatherMesh驱动的个性化洞察，该模型基于人工智能或其他技术实现。

一目了然获取完整预报，深入探索单一变量，或对比多个地点的天气状况。寻找跑步、飞行或未规划行程的最佳天气窗口——或在地图上实时观察风暴、锋面、风力和降水的变化。

payload.name: Secondhand Marketplace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Depop, and Poshmark all without leaving ChatGPT. Search in plain language:  "a mid-century dresser under $250 near Denver" or "Lululemon Align leggings, size 6, under $60 near me"  and get real listings with prices, photos, seller details, and links. 

Filter by price, condition, brand, size, color and more. Have chat perform specific filters on analyzing photos for condition, or getting the right shade of brown that would take ages to do yourself on a manual marketplace search. Get local results, or items to ship. Every listing's full photo set is available so you can judge condition right in the conversation.  Free to start, no setup required.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可搜索 Facebook Marketplace、eBay、Depop 和 Poshmark。用自然语言搜索，例如：“丹佛附近 $250 以下的世纪中期梳妆柜”或“我附近 $60 以下、6 码的 Lululemon Align 紧身裤”，即可获取真实商品列表及价格、照片、卖家详情和链接。

按价格、成色、品牌、尺码、颜色等条件筛选。你可以让聊天根据照片分析成色，或找出合适的棕色色调；若手动在交易平台搜索，这些筛选可能要花很久。获取本地结果或可邮寄的商品。每个商品列表都提供完整照片集，方便你直接在对话中判断成色。免费开始使用，无需设置。

payload.name: Spotts - Korea Festival
payload.description: 查找韩国的公开活动和节日信息。
payload.summaryOriginal: 한국의 공개 행사와 축제 정보를 찾아봅니다.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Spotts에서 한국의 공개 행사와 축제 정보를 검색하고 행사 일정·지역·종류·공개된 출연자 정보를 확인합니다. 읽기 전용으로 동작하며 사용자 계정 데이터나 예약·결제를 처리하지 않습니다.
payload.longDescription: 在Spotts中搜索韩国的公开活动和节日信息，可查看活动时间表、地区、类型及公开的演出者信息。该插件仅以只读方式运行，不处理用户账户数据或预订/支付操作。

payload.name: LiveSpot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LiveSpot is an independent Swedish event guide. Ask in plain language - "what's on in Gothenburg this weekend", "concerts in Stockholm under 500 SEK" - and get current events with venue, date, price and a direct link to book. Search by free text, city, category, date range or budget; open full event details with description, venue, availability and ticket links; browse by city or category; and find similar events to one you like. Covers concerts, theatre, musicals, dance, comedy, sport, festivals and family events across Sweden, collected daily from 13 ticketing providers. Free and read-only: no account, no API key.
payload.longDescription: LiveSpot 是独立的瑞典活动指南。用自然语言提问——“本周末哥德堡有什么活动？”“斯德哥尔摩 500 SEK 以下的音乐会”——即可获得带场馆、日期、价格和直接购票链接的当前活动。可按自由文本、城市、类别、日期范围或预算搜索；打开包含描述、场馆、可用性和票务链接的完整活动详情；按城市或类别浏览；查找与你喜欢的活动相似的活动。覆盖瑞典各地的音乐会、戏剧、音乐剧、舞蹈、喜剧、体育、节庆和家庭活动，每天从 13 家票务提供商收集信息。免费且只读：无需账户或 API 密钥。

payload.name: AjmerAstro
payload.description: 印度历法、出生星盘及KP星盘
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask in plain language — "today's panchang for Delhi", "my kundali for 18 June 1984, 3:55 PM, Ajmer, Rajasthan", "the KP chart for those details" — and get the computed values back.

Panchang and muhurat. Tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana and vara for any date and
place, with the rahukaal, yamaganda and gulika windows, the abhijit muhurat and
the full choghadiya — the things people actually check before fixing a time to
begin something.

Janam kundali. Ascendant, planetary positions with nakshatra and pada, the D1
and D9 charts, the current mahadasha and antardasha, and whether Manglik dosha
is present.

KP charts. Cuspal positions with sign lord, star lord and sub lord, plus the
planetary significators.

Birth place lookup. Returns matching cities with their timezone, so an ambiguous
name can be confirmed before a chart is drawn. Timezones are worked out for the
exact date — a July birth in London uses BST, not GMT.

No account and no sign-up. Results are astronomical calculations and traditional
Vedic classifications — not predictions, and not medical, legal or financial
advice.
payload.longDescription:
用日常语言提问——“德里今天的panchang”“我的出生星盘，1984年6月18日，下午3:55，拉贾斯坦邦阿杰梅尔”“这些信息对应的KP星盘”——即可获取计算结果。

Panchang历法与muhurat吉时。查询任意日期和
地点的tithi、nakshatra、yoga、karana和vara，以及rahukaal、yamaganda和gulika时段、abhijit muhurat
和完整choghadiya——这些都是人们在确定
开始某项事务的时间之前实际会查看的内容。

Janam kundali出生星盘。上升点、行星位置及其nakshatra和pada、D1
与D9星盘、当前的mahadasha和antardasha，以及是否存在Manglik dosha
。

KP星盘。宫头位置及其星座主星、星宿主星和次主星，以及
行星指示星。

出生地查询。返回匹配城市及其时区，以便在绘制星盘前确认
有歧义的地名。时区按确切日期计算
——7月在伦敦出生使用BST，而非GMT。

无需账户或注册。结果为天文计算和传统
吠陀分类——并非预测，也不是医疗、法律或财务
建议。

payload.name: Guanyin Oracle · 观音灵签
payload.description: 以中文为主的灵签仪式
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Guanyin Oracle offers a quiet, Chinese-first reflection ritual based on a bundled 100-sign Guanyin corpus. Hold one focused question, make one symbolic draw, then confirm it with one symbolic cup action. The source sign poem and traditional note remain in Chinese, with a detailed interpretation in Chinese and faithful English.

Each reading connects the sign to the question, distinguishes reflection from prediction, and offers practical seven-day actions and clear boundaries for health, financial, legal, and other consequential topics. Users may optionally save a JPEG card for the exact sign they drew. The service processes only inputs needed to return the reading and does not persist ritual sessions.
payload.longDescription:
Guanyin Oracle 提供宁静的中文优先反思仪式，基于内置的观音 100 签内容。专注于一个问题，象征性地抽取一签，再以一次象征性的掷杯动作确认。原始签诗和传统注解保留中文，并提供详细的中文解读及忠实的英文译文。

每次解读都会结合问题说明签意，区分反思与预测，并针对健康、财务、法律及其他重大议题提供切实可行的七日行动建议和明确边界。用户还可选择为抽中的确切签号保存 JPEG 签卡。服务仅处理生成解读所需的输入，不会保存仪式会话。

payload.name: xmplaylist
payload.description: 探索 SiriusXM 播放记录
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore SiriusXM airplay tracked by xmplaylist. Find where a song played, discover new station additions, see a station’s most-played tracks, and compare changes in support for songs and artists. Read a briefing for your saved artist roster, then explore an individual artist’s songs, stations, and trends.

Results link back to xmplaylist reports and explain the selected time period and available coverage. With an explicit request, prepare a CSV export and receive its download link by email. You can also check your latest export’s status from chat.

Requires an xmplaylist account with API access. Requests share your plan’s daily API allowance. Recorded airplay may be incomplete; first detection is not a song’s release date. xmplaylist is not an official SiriusXM product.
payload.longDescription:
探索 xmplaylist 跟踪的 SiriusXM 播放记录。查找歌曲在哪些地方播放、发现新加入电台的歌曲、查看电台播放次数最多的曲目，并比较歌曲和艺人获得的支持变化。查看已保存艺人名单的简报，再深入了解单个艺人的歌曲、电台和趋势。

结果会链接回 xmplaylist 报告，并说明所选时间段和可用覆盖范围。经你明确请求后，可准备 CSV 导出文件，并通过电子邮件发送下载链接。你也可以在聊天中查看最近一次导出的状态。

需要拥有 API 访问权限的 xmplaylist 账号。请求会占用你套餐的每日 API 配额。已记录的播放情况可能不完整；首次检测日期并不代表歌曲发行日期。xmplaylist 不是 SiriusXM 官方产品。

payload.name: Autotrader
payload.summaryOriginal: Search for new and used cars
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

payload.longDescription: Slide15 是一款无需离开 ChatGPT 即可游玩的滑块拼图。只需请求一个谜题，棋盘就会出现在对话中：滑动、轻点或使用方向键移动数字方块，直到数字按顺序排列。每个谜题都通过合法移动打乱，因此总能解出。可随时生成新棋盘，还提供计时器、步数计数器、供新手查看的简短玩法说明，以及完整的英语、俄语和西班牙语本地化。无需账户，除匿名使用分析外不会收集其他数据。同一款游戏也可在 slide15.com、iPhone 和 iPad 上免费游玩。

payload.name: Triad Astro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Triad Astro reads your birth chart in three astrological traditions at once - Western (Tropical), Vedic (Sidereal), and Chinese (BaZi / Four Pillars) - and shows you where they agree.

Give it a birth date, plus a time and place if you know them, and it calculates all three charts in a single step: Sun, Moon and rising signs, planetary aspects and elemental balance from the Western system; Nakshatra, Navamsa, planetary dignity and the Vimshottari Dasha timeline from the Vedic system; and the Four Pillars, Day Master and ten-year Luck Pillars from the Chinese system.

Most astrology tools give you one system's answer. Triad Astro gives you three, then helps you read the overlap - the themes that show up independently in all three are the ones worth a closer look.

Planetary positions are computed from ephemeris data aligned to NASA JPL standards, and birth places are resolved to coordinates with automatic timezone handling, so charts are accurate to the minute when the birth time is known. Ambiguous place names can be looked up first so you can confirm the right city.

No account or sign-in is required. Just ask for a reading - for example: "Calculate my tri-system birth chart. I was born March 14, 1990 at 7:45am in Bangalore, India."
payload.longDescription:
Triad Astro 同时依据 3 种占星传统解读你的出生星盘——西方占星（回归黄道）、吠陀占星（恒星黄道）和中国命理（八字/四柱）——并展示它们的共通之处。

大多数占星工具只给出一种体系的解读。Triad Astro 会提供 3 种解读，并帮助你查看其重叠之处——那些在 3 种体系中各自独立出现的主题，值得进一步关注。

行星位置依据符合 NASA JPL 标准的星历数据计算；出生地点会解析为坐标并自动处理时区，因此在已知出生时间时，星盘时间可精确到分钟。遇到含义不明确的地名时，可先查询并确认正确城市。

无需账户或登录。只需请求解读，例如：“计算我的三体系出生星盘。我出生于 1990 年 March 14 日上午 7:45，地点是 India 的 Bangalore。”

payload.name: TNT Sweeper

payload.name: WhatsTheID
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Ask what was played in a set, which track is playing at a given moment of a video, which sets a track has been played in, or what a channel has uploaded recently. Estimated times are marked as estimates. If a set is not on WhatsTheID yet, the assistant says so and gives a link to add it; it never guesses a tracklist.

Tools:
- Search DJ sets: find sets by DJ, event, festival, club, channel or genre.
- Get set tracklist: the full tracklist of one set from its YouTube link.
- Find track at timestamp: the track playing at a moment like 42:10, with the previous and next tracks.
- Search tracks: find a track and the sets it was played in.
- Latest sets from a channel: a channel's newest sets with tracklists.

Read-only, with no account needed. Each answer is small (one tracklist or up to ten results) and links back to whatstheid.com.
payload.longDescription:
WhatsTheID将您的助手连接至其收录的YouTube DJ混音曲目数据库。您可以询问某个混音集中播放了哪些曲目，视频特定时刻正在播放的曲目，某首曲目曾出现在哪些混音集中，或某频道最近上传了哪些内容。答案来自WhatsTheID的公开曲目列表，并附有完整曲目列表链接以及YouTube上的具体时间点链接。

- 获取混音集曲目列表：通过YouTube链接获取某个混音集的完整曲目列表。
- 通过时间戳查找曲目：查找如42:10这样的特定时刻正在播放的曲目，包含前后曲目信息。

- 查看频道最新混音集：展示某频道最新上传的混音集及其曲目列表。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CarGene answers questions about the history of Japanese cars from a curated database: which generations of a model were sold and when, their chassis codes, the engineers who developed them, how generations relate (successor, sibling, derivative), and sales figures by country and year. Each fact comes with the source it was taken from. Read-only, no account needed.
payload.longDescription: CarGene通过一个精心整理的数据库回答关于日本汽车历史的问题：某款车型经历了哪些代际、何时上市、车架代码是什么、开发它们的工程师是谁、各代际之间有何关联（如后续代际、同级车型或衍生车型），以及按国家和年份统计的销售数据。每个事实都标明了来源。只读模式，无需账户。

payload.name: KiedyKoncert
payload.description: KiedyKoncert.pl 是波兰的演唱会日历
payload.longDescription:
KiedyKoncert.pl 是波兰的演唱会日历。该插件允许您询问助手，某位选定的艺人何时演出，某个城市或周边地区在特定日期有哪些演唱会，以及具体演唱会的详细信息。

功能包括：
- 根据艺人或活动名称（支持拼写修正）、城市及10-100公里半径范围、日期或快捷方式（"今天"、"本周末"、"下个月"）以及音乐类型搜索即将举行的演唱会；
- 展示艺人巡演的所有已公布日期及取消场次；
- 显示演唱会详细信息：艺人名称、日期、入场和开场时间（如有）、场地和地址、状态（包括售罄、取消、延期）、票价起始价及票务供应商名称；
- 列出各音乐类型对应的即将举行演唱会数量。

数据来源为俱乐部、场馆和文化中心的官方日历以及票务供应商。每个演唱会都会注明来源和最后确认日期。

插件不支持以下功能：
- 仅支持只读模式：不购买门票、不创建账户、不修改数据也不保存提醒；
- 不提供票务链接——每个演唱会均跳转至 KiedyKoncert.pl 的专属页面，该页面显示当前票务供应商；
- 仅涵盖波兰境内的演唱会，且日期从当天开始；
- 若日历中无演唱会会直接提示（"暂无即将举行的演唱会"），不会进行推测。

数据更新频率取决于来源方——出行前建议再次向主办方确认最新状态。

payload.name: Inkspired
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inkspired is a platform where authors write and publish serialized stories and build the universes behind them. This connector gives your AI assistant access to your own Inkspired author workspace, so it can help you write, revise and understand your work without copy-pasting.


What it can do:



Browse your work: list your stories and open any chapter, including drafts.

Draft and revise: create new stories and chapter drafts, and save changes to drafts.

Proofread safely: suggest corrections that you review and apply. Every change an assistant makes to a chapter is backed up first, so you can restore the previous version.

Build your world: create universes, link stories to them, and add, update or link glossary entries for characters, places and lore.

Understand your readers: read the comments and reviews on your chapters, see your writing stats, and view story performance. Performance includes reads, likes, retention and drop-off, demographics and rankings, within the limits of your plan.

Stay on top of activity: check your recent notifications.


What it can't do: it can never publish, schedule or delete anything. Those actions stay with you on Inkspired. It only has access to your own account, you approve its permissions when you connect, and you can disconnect it at any time.
payload.longDescription:
Inkspired是一个作者撰写和发布连载故事并构建其世界观的平台。该连接器可让您的人工智能助手访问您的Inkspired作者工作区，从而帮助您撰写、修改和理解作品，而无需复制粘贴。

它能做什么：

浏览您的作品：列出您的故事并打开任何章节，包括草稿。

撰写与修改：创建新故事和章节草稿，并保存草稿修改。

安全校对：提出需要您审阅并应用的修改建议。助手对章节的每次修改都会先进行备份，您可以恢复到之前的版本。

构建您的世界：创建世界观，将故事与之关联，并添加、更新或链接角色、地点和背景设定的术语表条目。

了解您的读者：查看章节的评论和评分，查阅写作数据并观察故事表现。表现数据包括阅读量、点赞数、留存率和流失率、受众统计数据和排名，具体取决于您的计划限制。

掌握活动动态：查看最近的通知。

它无法执行发布、排期或删除操作，这些操作仍由您在Inkspired上处理。它仅访问您的个人账户，连接时您需批准其权限，且可随时断开连接。

payload.name: Reading Your Love
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Reading Your Love (RYL) reads the relationship between two people as two gauges: temperature — your drive for romance — and humidity — the depth of feeling for the other person. Give both birth dates and birth cities (birth times sharpen it) and RYL shows an interactive card with where each of you sits on each gauge, named in RYL's own words (Lukewarm / Moderate / Hot, Dry / Moist / Damp). The card is a preview: the exact reading, with the full story behind it, is one tap away on readingyourlove.com, with your details already filled in.
payload.longDescription:
Reading Your Love（RYL）通过两个仪表盘展现两个人的关系：温度——你对浪漫的渴望程度，以及湿度——你对对方情感的深度。
提供双方的出生日期和出生城市（精确的出生时间能提升准确性），RYL会生成一张互动卡片，显示你们在每个仪表盘上的位置，卡片会用RYL特有的词汇进行命名（温热/适中/火热，干燥/湿润/潮湿）。
这张卡片仅作为预览：完整的解读及其中的详细故事，只需轻点一下即可在readingyourlove.com上查看，您的信息已预先填写完毕。

payload.name: MusicAtlas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MusicAtlas is the fastest way to discover music through sound across major streaming services. Find songs that sound like a track you love, explore similar artists, understand what makes a song sound the way it does, and discover playlists for any mood, genre, activity, or vibe. Listen to playable previews and jump to your favorite music service to hear more.
payload.longDescription:
MusicAtlas 是通过声音跨主流流媒体服务快速发现音乐的最快方式。
找到与您喜爱的歌曲风格相似的歌曲，探索相似艺术家，理解一首歌曲为何具有特定风格，并发现适合任何情绪、流派、活动或氛围的播放列表。
聆听可播放的试听片段，并跳转至您喜爱的音乐服务以了解更多。

payload.name: Form Guide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Football fixtures, results, form and league tables for the Premier League, Championship, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A and Ligue 1, current season (worked out from the date; 2026/27 now). Tables include official points deductions. Understands everyday club names (Spurs, Man Utd, Barca, PSG, Wolves, Nottm Forest, the Toon, Inter Milan), full spoken names and small typos (Liverpol, Nottingham Forrest). Clubs from other leagues that people often ask about (Celtic, Rangers, Ajax, Benfica, Inter Miami) get a 404 that says which league they play in. Every tool is read-only: no sign-in and nothing about the user is stored. There are no ads or paid placements. Built by Good Turn Studio. More at https://formguide.pages.dev

payload.name: Genie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Think of anything without telling me. Genie asks adaptive yes-or-no questions and tries to figure out what you're thinking of.
payload.longDescription: 在不告诉我任何信息的情况下，随意想点什么。Genie会提出自适应的二元问题，试图猜出你正在想什么。

payload.name: Tonada
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Describe your space and the atmosphere you want, get a suggested sonic identity, and hear matching samples from Tonada's curated music catalog. No Tonada account needed to listen.
payload.longDescription: 描述您的空间和期望的氛围，获取建议的声音标识，并试听Tonada精选音乐库中匹配的音频样本。无需Tonada账户即可试听。

payload.name: webook.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: webook.com is Saudi Arabia’s ultimate super-app for entertainment, travel, and lifestyle. It is the one-stop platform to discover and book concerts, sporting events, cultural shows, flights, hotels, restaurants, memorabilia, auctions, and more. Whether you are in Riyadh, Jeddah, the Eastern Province, or anywhere else in the Kingdom, webook.com connects you to everything exciting. With updated listings, verified bookings, and a simple interface, having fun and planning trips has never been easier.
payload.longDescription:
webook.com 是沙特阿拉伯的终极超级应用，涵盖娱乐、旅行和生活方式领域。
它是一站式平台，可发现并预订音乐会、体育赛事、文化演出、航班、酒店、餐厅、纪念品、拍卖活动等。
无论你身处利雅得、吉达、东部省还是王国其他地区，webook.com 都能让你接触到所有令人兴奋的活动。
拥有更新的列表、经过验证的预订和简洁的界面，享受乐趣和规划旅行从未如此简单。

payload.name: Mzelo Watch Party
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mzelo Watch Party sets up a private room on mzelo.com where friends can watch a YouTube video together, in sync, and chat while they watch.

Ask ChatGPT to watch something with friends and either share a YouTube link or say what you'd like to watch. Mzelo creates a room with that video ready to play and gives you a link. Share the link: anyone who has it can join from a browser, with no account or install needed. The first person to open the room gets the remote, so they can play and pause for everyone.

Who it's for: friends, couples, families and groups who live apart and want to watch the same video at the same time.

Limitations: works with public and unlisted YouTube videos that allow embedding; private, removed, age-restricted and embed-blocked videos can't be used. Each request creates one new room; asking again for the same video within a few minutes gives you the same room. When you describe a topic instead of giving a link, Mzelo picks one safe-search YouTube result. Rooms are created on mzelo.com, so watching happens there, not inside ChatGPT. To prevent abuse, the number of rooms one person can create per hour and per day is limited.
payload.longDescription:
Mzelo Watch Party在mzelo.com上创建一个私人房间，朋友可以在此同步观看YouTube视频并边看边聊天。

让ChatGPT邀请朋友一起观看某个内容，可分享YouTube链接或说明想观看的内容。
Mzelo会创建包含该视频的房间并生成链接。
分享链接：拥有链接的人可通过浏览器加入，无需账户或安装。
第一个打开房间的人将获得遥控器权限，可为所有人播放和暂停视频。

适用对象：分隔两地的朋友、情侣、家庭和群体用户，希望同步观看同一视频。

限制条件：仅支持允许嵌入的公开和未列出YouTube视频；私密、已移除、年龄限制和嵌入受限视频无法使用。
每次请求生成一个新房间；同一视频在数分钟内重复请求将获得相同房间。
当描述主题而非提供链接时，Mzelo会选取一个安全搜索的YouTube结果。
房间在mzelo.com创建，因此观看需在该网站进行，而非在ChatGPT内。
为防止滥用，每小时和每天创建房间的数量有限制。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create a private watch party room for a YouTube link, Find a YouTube video for a topic and create a room for it, Return a shareable room link anyone can join without an account

payload.name: Show & Tell
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Show & Tell is a daily photo game you play with ChatGPT. Everyone gets the same secret word each day, and only you can see it: it stays behind a Hold to reveal button, so ChatGPT never sees it. Show it with photos of the real world: your mug, your dog, the light through your window. After each photo, ChatGPT makes one guess and hears how close it is: cold, warm, hot, burning, or correct. Solve it in as few shots as you can.

- Six shots a day. Photos with letters, numbers, or screens are fouls and don't count.
- Stuck? Spend a hint: the category, the length, or the first letter.
- Keep a daily streak and share your score grid without spoiling the word.

A new word unlocks at midnight where you are. No sign-up needed.
payload.longDescription:
Show & Tell 是一个你与 ChatGPT 一起每天游玩的照片游戏。
每天所有人都会获得相同的秘密单词，只有你能看到它：它被隐藏在「按住以显示」按钮后，因此 ChatGPT 永远看不到。
用现实世界的照片展示它：你的杯子、你的狗、你窗前的光线。
每张照片后，ChatGPT 会做出一次猜测，并听到它有多接近：冰冷、温暖、火热、燃烧或正确。
用尽可能少的尝试次数解开谜题。

- 每天六次机会。
包含字母、数字或屏幕的照片视为犯规，不计入次数。
- 卡住了？
消耗一个提示：获取类别、长度或首字母信息。
- 保持每日连续打卡，并分享你的得分表格而不泄露答案。

你所在时区的午夜会解锁新单词。
无需注册即可使用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Start today's round, Guess the secret word from your photos, Call fouls for photos with letters, numbers, or screens, Give hints when you ask for one, Track your daily streak

payload.name: ioreum Saju
payload.description: 韩式四柱命理图，精准计算
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ioreum calculates Korean saju (四柱, Four Pillars of Destiny) charts the way a professional would: solar-term boundaries computed astronomically to the minute, true solar time from the birthplace, and the late-night hour convention. Ask for a chart, the 10-year luck pillars (daeun), which zodiac animal a January or February birth really belongs to, or a reference for any of the sixty day-pillar characters. Tools return calculated facts only and take nothing but the birth details you give them. Nothing here predicts events; treat it as reference and entertainment. Supported birth years: 1900 to 2050.
payload.longDescription:
ioreum以专业方式计算韩式四柱（四柱，八字）命理图：节气边界通过天文学精确到分钟计算，出生地真太阳时，以及夜间时辰惯例。
可查询命理图、10年运势柱（大运），判断1月或2月出生者真正所属的生肖，或任意六十日柱字符的参考信息。
工具仅返回计算结果，仅需提供出生信息即可。
此处内容不预测具体事件；请作为参考和娱乐用途。
支持出生年份：1900年至2050年。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Calculate a saju / BaZi chart, List 10-year luck pillars, Check the zodiac-year boundary, Explain day-pillar characters

payload.name: ChessEver
payload.description: 实时关注国际象棋赛事
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Follow live chess with ChessEver. Find tournaments around the world, see what’s live, and catch up on recorded results.

Ask about an event, explore its rounds and game moves, then open the exact game on ChessEver to watch or replay.

Built for players, coaches, clubs, and fans who want a clean, simple way to stay close to the games that matter. Follow chess better.

Broadcast data may be delayed or incomplete. Recorded score leaders are not certified official final standings.
payload.longDescription:
通过ChessEver关注实时国际象棋赛事。
查找全球赛事，查看实时进行中的比赛，并回顾已录制的比赛结果。

了解赛事详情，查看赛事轮次和对局进展，然后在ChessEver打开具体对局观看或回放。

专为棋手、教练、俱乐部和粉丝打造，提供简洁清晰的方式，紧贴重要赛事。
更高效地关注国际象棋。

直播数据可能存在延迟或不完整。
录播积分排名未经认证，非官方最终排名。

payload.name: Coronet Arcade
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Play today's thirteen Coronet Arcade logic and word puzzles in an interactive hub. Open a daily board, use its normal controls and finite hints, or ask for the rules without spoilers. The daily boards match Coronet Arcade. Progress stays in the active widget; some unfinished boards reset when you switch games. This integration has no signup, account synchronization, archive, unlimited practice or purchase flow. An optional website link offers more ways to play.
payload.longDescription:
在互动中心体验今日的13道Coronet Arcade逻辑谜题和文字谜题。
打开每日棋盘，使用常规操作和有限提示，或询问规则且不剧透。
每日棋盘与Coronet Arcade一致。
进度保存在活动组件中；部分未完成棋盘在切换游戏时会重置。
此集成不提供注册、账户同步、存档、无限练习或购买流程。
可选的网站链接提供更多游玩方式。

payload.name: Wix Events Discovery
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Wix Events Discovery finds upcoming in-person events hosted on Wix sites: local concerts, workshops, classes, meetups, festivals and more, mostly in the US, UK, Europe, Canada and Australia. Search by place, dates, genre or activity tags, keywords, category and price, then open an event for its description, venue, prices and the other dates of a recurring series.

Every result links to the organizer's own event page, where tickets are sold; Wix Events Discovery doesn't book or buy tickets. Prices may exclude fees and taxes, so the organizer's page has the final price. Events for adults only (18+) aren't listed, and online-only events can't be found reliably.
payload.longDescription:
Wix Events Discovery可查找在Wix网站上举办的即将举行的线下活动，包括本地音乐会、研讨会、课程、聚会、节日等，主要覆盖美国、英国、欧洲、加拿大和澳大利亚地区。通过地点、日期、类型或活动标签、关键词、类别和价格进行搜索，点击活动查看其描述、场地、价格以及定期系列活动的其他日期。

每个搜索结果均链接至活动组织者的独立页面，门票在此页面销售；Wix Events Discovery不提供票务预订或购买服务。价格可能不包含费用和税款，因此组织者页面显示的最终价格为准。仅限成人（18岁以上）的活动不会列出，纯线上活动无法可靠检索。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search upcoming events, Get event details

payload.name: CollegeSeats
payload.description: 大学体育赛事转售门票
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CollegeSeats is a ticket resale marketplace built only for college sports, starting with SEC football. Ask about a team, a matchup, a stadium or a weekend, and CollegeSeats shows the upcoming games and the tickets for sale: section, row, how many seats sit together, the price per ticket with fees included, and the total for your order.

Every listing has a Buy button that opens collegeseats.com with those seats already selected. Checkout happens on our site; nothing is bought or reserved from inside ChatGPT, and no sign-in is needed to search.

CollegeSeats is a secondary-market resale site, not the official or primary seller. Prices are set by sellers and may be above or below face value. Sales tax is added at checkout. Your payment is held until your tickets arrive. If they never do, you get every cent back.
payload.longDescription:
CollegeSeats是一个仅限大学体育赛事的票务转售市场，最初专注于SEC足球赛事。询问一支球队、一场对阵、一座体育场或一个周末，CollegeSeats将展示即将进行的比赛以及可售门票信息，包括座位区域、排数、连座数量、每张票价格（含费用）以及订单总价。

每个商品列表都配有「购买」按钮，点击后将跳转至collegeseats.com并自动选中对应座位。结账操作在我们的网站完成；通过ChatGPT内部不会进行任何购买或预留操作，搜索时也无需登录。

CollegeSeats是二级市场转售网站，并非官方或原始销售方。价格由卖家设定，可能高于或低于票面价值。结账时会增加销售税。您的付款将被暂存，直至门票送达。若门票未能送达，您将获得全额退款。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find upcoming college games by team, matchup, stadium or date, List resale tickets with prices per ticket, fees included, Link to checkout on collegeseats.com with the seats selected

payload.name: ZoneFoundry for Sonos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Control the Sonos speakers in your home by talking to ChatGPT. Play songs, artists, albums and playlists, set the volume, group rooms together, move the music to another room, switch to TV, and have a speaker read out a short announcement or a timed reminder. It works in English and Chinese and goes through the official Sonos cloud, so there is nothing to install on your network and it works when you are away from home. You need the free ZoneFoundry iOS app, signed in to your own Sonos account; when you connect, you approve access in the app with a 6-digit code, and you can disconnect ChatGPT from the app at any time.
payload.longDescription: 通过与ChatGPT对话，控制家中的Sonos扬声器。播放歌曲、艺术家、专辑和播放列表，调节音量，将房间分组，将音乐移动到其他房间，切换至电视，并让扬声器播放简短公告或定时提醒。该功能支持英语和中文，通过官方Sonos云服务运行，无需在您的网络上安装任何东西，即使您不在家也能正常使用。您需要下载免费的ZoneFoundry iOS应用，登录您的Sonos账户；连接时通过6位数代码在应用中批准访问权限，可随时从应用中解除ChatGPT的连接。

payload.name: Daily Horoscope
payload.description: 占星术、黄道十二宫与塔罗牌
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore daily, weekly, monthly and yearly horoscopes for the 12 zodiac signs; discover Sun, Moon and Rising signs from birth details; compare sign compatibility; check Moon phases and planet retrogrades; draw one- or three-card tarot spreads; and explore lucky days, Chinese zodiac and numerology. Interactive cards include period tabs, tarot reveals and share-image controls. Content availability and language support vary. For entertainment and self-reflection only. Readings are not factual predictions or guidance for health, financial, legal, safety or relationship decisions.
payload.longDescription:
探索12星座的每日、每周、每月和年度星盘；根据出生信息发现太阳、月亮和上升星座；比较星座相容性；查看月相和行星逆行；抽取一张或三张塔罗牌阵；探索幸运日、中国生肖和占星术。
互动卡片包含周期标签、塔罗揭示和分享图片控制。
内容可用性和语言支持可能因地区而异。
仅供娱乐和自我反思使用。

payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中实时查看Roblox游戏的玩家数量与趋势。询问任何Roblox游戏的当前玩家数量，并查看其过去7天的玩家数量图表。实时获取当前最热门的Roblox游戏，或查看模拟类、障碍赛、经营类、角色扮演等分类中的热门游戏。发现本周增长最快的传统热门游戏，并可在7至90天周期内将最多六款游戏绘制在同一张趋势图中。本工具专为研究游戏类型与竞品的Roblox开发者，以及想了解热门游戏的玩家设计。每款游戏均链接至CCUCheck平台及Roblox官方页面。CCUCheck为独立平台，与Roblox公司无任何关联。

payload.name: TodoWeekend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TodoWeekend is an independent guide to things to do on the weekend in Madrid, Barcelona, Lisboa, Paris, Berlin, London, Miami, Santiago de Chile and Tokyo. Ask what is on this weekend, today or tomorrow, or for concerts, exhibitions, theatre, family plans or free events. You get up to 12 curated listings as cards, with the date, venue, price when known, and a link to the TodoWeekend page. Ask for details on any listing to see the full description, address, map point and the seller's own ticket link.

Limits: TodoWeekend covers only the nine cities above. Listings are suitable for ages 13 and up, and nightlife and alcohol-led events are left out. Every answer shows the date the city's data was last updated, and a notice appears when it is more than seven days old, so check the event page before you go. TodoWeekend does not sell tickets and does not need an account. The plugin only reads public listings.
payload.longDescription:
TodoWeekend是马德里、巴塞罗那、里斯本、巴黎、柏林、伦敦、迈阿密、圣地亚哥和东京的周末活动独立指南。询问本周、今天或明天的活动安排，或了解音乐会、展览、戏剧、家庭活动及免费活动信息。您将获得最多12条精选列表卡片，显示日期、场所、已知价格及跳转至TodoWeekend页面的链接。可查看任意列表的详细信息，包含完整描述、地址、地图标记及卖家提供的票务链接。

限制条件：TodoWeekend仅覆盖上述九个城市。所有活动适合13岁及以上人群，不包含夜生活及以酒精为主的活动。每次回答会显示城市数据最后更新日期，若超过七天未更新会特别提示，请出行前查看活动页面。TodoWeekend不销售门票，无需账户即可使用。插件仅读取公开列表。

payload.name: Cosmic Rebellion

payload.name: Cookie Stack with Ottie

payload.name: Art Spotter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Art Spotter finds original art and prints sold directly by independent artists, and helps artists sell.

One search covers about 21,000 works in 190 independent artists' own shops (checked live for availability) and eBay art, with search links for Saatchi Art, Etsy, Artfinder and Singulart. It also suggests a fair value for new work by size and medium, wall sizing, scam checks, what each selling platform leaves an artist after fees, commission pricing and contract points, open calls and grants in the UK, US and Canada, UK resale royalty maths, and an artwork passport. Nothing about users is stored.
payload.longDescription:
Art Spotter 为独立艺术家直接销售的原创艺术品和印刷品提供发现服务，并帮助艺术家进行销售。

一次搜索可覆盖190位独立艺术家个人店铺（实时检查库存情况）及eBay艺术区的约21,000件作品，提供Saatchi Art、Etsy、Artfinder和Singulart的搜索链接。还提供新作品的尺寸和媒介合理估值、墙面尺寸建议、欺诈检查、各销售平台扣除费用后艺术家实际收益、佣金定价与合同要点、英美加三国的公开征集与资助项目、英国转售版税计算以及艺术品护照功能。不存储任何用户信息。

payload.name: LetterLab Word Solver
payload.description: 单词游戏求解器与乱序单词重组工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LetterLab Word Solver is a word game helper: it unscrambles letters, fills in crossword patterns and narrows down answers in 5-letter guessing games. It looks answers up in a real English dictionary (the ENABLE word list, 172,569 words, with slurs and obscenities removed), so every result is a real word from that list.

Unscramble: type your letters, with ? or * for blank tiles, and see the words you can make, grouped by length with counts and tile points (standard letter values, blanks score 0). Filter by exact length, minimum length, use all letters, starts with, ends with, or contains. Words that use all your tiles are called out.

Crossword and pattern search: type the letters you know and ? for each unknown one (C?T, _A_E_, ??ANGE), or * for any run of letters (S*ING). Add letters that must appear or must not appear. Common words are listed first, then rarer ones.

5-letter guessing games: enter your guesses and the green, yellow and gray feedback (G, Y and - or colored squares). The solver applies the repeated-letter rules, counts and lists the words that still fit, and ranks next guesses by expected information, with the average and worst-case number of words left. Hard mode and 4- to 8-letter variants are supported.

The interactive card shows your letter tiles, word groups with counts you can filter by length, a pattern search, and a tap-to-color guess grid that re-solves as you play.

Limitations: English words from the ENABLE list only (no proper nouns, abbreviations or one-letter words, and some newer words are missing); tile points are face values without board bonuses; it does not define words, solve clues by meaning, or know any game's daily answer.
payload.longDescription:
LetterLab单词求解器是一款单词游戏辅助工具：它可以解乱序字母、填充填字游戏模式，并在5字母猜词游戏中缩小答案范围。该工具通过真实的英文词典（ENABLE单词列表，包含172,569个单词，已去除辱骂和粗俗用语）查询答案，因此所有结果均来自该列表中的合法单词。

解乱序功能：输入你的字母（可用?或*表示空白瓷砖），即可查看能组成的单词，按长度分组显示并附有数量和瓷砖分数（标准字母分值，空白瓷砖得分为0）。可按精确长度、最小长度、必须使用所有字母、起始字母、结尾字母或包含字母进行筛选。使用所有字母组成的单词会特别标注。

填字游戏与模式搜索：输入已知字母并用?表示单个未知字母（如C?T、_A_E_、??ANGE），或用*表示任意字母组合（如S*ING）。可添加必须包含或必须排除的字母。常见单词会优先列出，然后是较生僻的单词。

5字母猜词游戏：输入你的猜测及绿色、黄色和灰色反馈（G、Y和-或彩色方块）。求解器会应用重复字母规则，统计并列出仍符合条件的单词，按预期信息量对下一步猜测进行排序，并显示平均和最坏情况下的剩余单词数量。支持硬模式及4至8字母变体。

交互式卡片显示你的字母瓷砖、可按长度过滤的单词分组、模式搜索功能，以及点击变色的猜测网格，让你在游戏过程中实时重新求解。

限制条件：仅支持ENABLE单词列表中的英文单词（不含专有名词、缩写或单字母单词，部分新单词可能缺失）；瓷砖分数仅计算字母基础分值，不包含棋盘加分；无法定义单词含义、通过语义解答谜题，也不知晓任何游戏的每日答案。

payload.name: Artist Advisory
payload.description: 音乐艺术家的真实数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Artist Advisory shows where a music artist stands, with real numbers instead of guesses.

Name an artist and Artist Advisory shows their career score and tier, their monthly listeners, and their Spotify, TikTok and Instagram followers. Every number shows the day it was checked and how it moved over the last 28 days, so you always know how fresh it is.

Ask how an artist compares and Artist Advisory lines them up against artists at the same level: where they are ahead, where they are behind, and the one gap most worth working on. Ask where a number comes from and it shows the platform, the date it was checked, and how many of the last 28 days it was recorded.

Nothing is estimated. If Artist Advisory hasn't tracked an artist yet, it says so instead of guessing, and points to artistadvisory.io, where a report on that artist can be started.

No account is needed. Artist Advisory only reads numbers it has already collected from public profiles. It does not sign in to any platform, post anything, or change anything. It never receives your conversation: only the artist name or Spotify link you asked about, which is used to find the artist and is not stored.
payload.longDescription:
Artist Advisory 通过真实数据而非猜测，展示音乐艺术家的现状。

输入艺术家名称后，Artist Advisory 会显示其职业评分和层级、月度听众数量，以及 Spotify、TikTok 和 Instagram 粉丝数。每个数据都会显示检查日期以及过去28天的变化情况，让您随时了解数据的新鲜度。

询问艺术家的对比情况时，Artist Advisory 会将他们与同级别艺术家进行对比：显示哪些方面领先、哪些方面落后，以及最值得改进的差距。询问数据来源时，会显示平台、检查日期以及过去28天中记录的天数。

所有数据均为实际记录。如果 Artist Advisory 尚未追踪某位艺术家，会明确说明而非猜测，并指向 artistadvisory.io，您可以在该网站为该艺术家生成报告。

无需账户即可使用。Artist Advisory 仅读取已从公开资料中收集的数字。它不会登录任何平台、发布内容或修改任何内容。它不会保存您的对话记录：仅会使用您询问的艺术家名称或 Spotify 链接来查找艺术家，且该信息不会被存储。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Show an artist's career score, tier and audience numbers, each with the day it was checked, Show how each number moved over the last 28 days, Compare an artist with artists at the same level, with their biggest strength and gap, Show where a number comes from: the platform, the date and how often it was recorded, Say plainly when an artist isn't tracked yet instead of guessing

payload.name: Mythsensus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mythsensus runs one birth date through 26 astrology and divination traditions — BaZi, Vedic, Western, Nine Star Ki, Thai astrology and more — and puts the answers side by side. Instead of one voice, you see where the traditions agree and where they openly disagree, with each tradition's own rule shown.

In ChatGPT you can get a Cosmic Score from five core systems, a daily reading, the lore of 1,069 deities across 20+ mythologies, and the actual rules each system uses to calculate.

Mythsensus is for reflection and cultural curiosity, not advice. It gives no lottery numbers and makes no guarantees about outcomes.
payload.longDescription:
Mythsensus将同一出生日期输入26种占星与占卜传统——包括八字、吠陀占星、西方占星、九星气、泰国占星等——并将结果并列展示。您将看到各体系间的共识与分歧，每种体系的规则均以自身方式呈现

在ChatGPT中可获取五大核心系统的宇宙分数、每日运势、20多个神话体系中1069位神祇的神话传说，以及各系统实际使用的计算规则

Mythsensus用于反思与文化探索，不提供具体建议。不提供彩票号码，不对结果作出任何保证

payload.name: Julius: Sports Stats & Fantasy
payload.description: 体育数据和球员统计数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Julius is a sports stats and fantasy sports assistant for comparing players, teams and seasons. Explore sports data from uploaded files, saved Julius files or accessible public sources, then create custom rankings, charts and matchup reports.

Player and team comparisons: Analyze game logs, box scores, season totals, per-game averages, head-to-head results and home-away splits. Compare NBA basketball, NFL football, soccer, MLB baseball and NHL hockey statistics when the relevant data is available.

Fantasy football and fantasy basketball: Calculate fantasy points using your league's PPR, half-PPR, standard or custom scoring settings. Compare players, prepare draft cheat sheets and evaluate fantasy roster scenarios. Use supplied or retrievable, dated rankings and projections for trade analysis, start/sit questions, waiver wire research and average draft position (ADP) comparisons.

Sports analytics: Explore shooting efficiency, passing, rushing and receiving production, targets, goals and assists, batting and pitching trends, and other sport-specific metrics. Analyze expected goals (xG), shot locations and advanced statistics when the source includes the required fields.

Create sports charts, player comparison tables, scouting notes and reports. Save your work privately in Julius, continue it later, and publish a saved file when you ask for a public link.

Coverage and freshness depend on your inputs and accessible sources. Results identify the season, date range and assumptions used. Connect your Julius account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
Julius是一款体育数据和幻想体育助手，用于比较球员、球队和赛季。通过上传文件、保存的Julius文件或可访问的公开来源探索体育数据，然后创建自定义排名、图表和对阵报告。

球员和球队比较：分析比赛记录、技术统计、赛季总数据、场均数据、交锋记录和主客场分差。当相关数据可用时，可比较NBA篮球、NFL橄榄球、足球、MLB棒球和NHL冰球统计数据。

幻想足球和幻想篮球：根据联盟的PPR、半PPR、标准或自定义计分规则计算幻想分数。比较球员、准备选秀速查表并评估幻想阵容情景。使用提供的或可获取的日期相关排名和预测进行交易分析、首发/替补决策、自由市场研究和平均选秀顺位（ADP）对比。

体育分析：探索投篮效率、传球、跑球和接球产量、目标、进球和助攻、击球和投球趋势以及其他运动特定指标。当数据源包含必要字段时，分析预期进球（xG）、射门位置和高级统计数据。

创建体育图表、球员比较表格、球探笔记和报告。在Julius中私密保存工作内容，稍后继续编辑，并在需要时通过公共链接发布保存的文件。

覆盖范围和数据新鲜度取决于您的输入和可访问的数据源。结果会标明使用的赛季、日期范围和假设条件。连接您的Julius账户即可开始使用。

payload.name: Statz Football
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Look up football (soccer) statistics and Statz model projections in ChatGPT.

Ask for today's or tomorrow's matches, or one league over the coming days (Premier League, Champions League, La Liga, Ligue 1, Serie A, Bundesliga, Saudi Pro League, Egyptian Premier League, Botola Pro, Liga MX, Brasileirão and MLS). Each match comes with the chance of a home win, a draw and an away win, the AI's pick, the kickoff time and a link to its kickwise.ai page with lineups, the live score and where to watch.

About an hour before kickoff, once the confirmed lineups are out, the AI also predicts the exact final score. Ask for a match summary and Kickwise gives the AI's preview before kickoff, a live reading during the match or a recap after it, written from recent form, the confirmed lineups and injuries, formations, statistics and key moments, together with both starting lineups and formations. Once a match is over, Kickwise says whether the pick and the exact score were right.

What makes Kickwise different is that every call is made before kickoff, time stamped and graded in public at kickwise.ai/ai/record, misses included. As of 21 October 2026, its confident picks (the AI gave its pick 65% or more) were right 84% of the time over the last 90 days (54 of 64), against 63% for always picking the home team on the same matches; across every call in the last 30 days it was right 65% of the time (82 of 126).

No account needed: the tools receive only the team, league, day and language a question needs, never your conversation or anything about you, as the privacy policy at kickwise.ai/privacy sets out. Team names and links in English, Spanish, French, Arabic or Portuguese. The predictions are estimates for entertainment and discussion, not betting advice: Kickwise shows no odds and does not offer or promote betting.
